description: Find MEPs by name, country, political group, gender, parliamentary term, or mandate date. Omitting term and mandate_date selects members in office today; term selects that published term roster; mandate_date selects members seated on that date. Name matching requires every normalized token after case, diacritic, and punctuation normalization over the complete roster before paging. Country and group are published for the selected roster, never inferred for another date. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; restart at offset 0 without snapshot after snapshot_changed. Read identity and membership history with euparl_get_mep. Empty matches succeed with guidance.

country.description: Supported ISO alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive. United Kingdom members are published as GB (UK accepted), on historical rosters only. See euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters.

gender.description: Supported gender code FEMALE, MALE, NAP, NKN, or NST, case-insensitive.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20. Pages hold at most 300 MEPs; a larger limit returns that many with a notice.

mandate_date.description: Members holding a seat on this YYYY-MM-DD date, not after today (UTC); exclusive with term. Country and group are matched and returned as published on that date. A term's first sitting day can return an incomplete roster or an upstream error; use the following day.

name_contains.description: All-token name filter over the complete selected roster; case, diacritics, and punctuation are normalized, without fuzzy scoring. Must keep at least one letter or digit.

political_group.description: Supported political group code, case-insensitive; accepts EPP, S&D, Verts/ALE, Greens/EFA, The Left, GUE/NGL, Renew, PfE, and Patriots aliases. Query aliases never rewrite historical organization identities. With mandate_date it matches only the code in force on that date; for earlier groups omit it and read each member's published political_group. See euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters.

snapshot.description: Returned roster snapshot; required for offset above 0, optional at offset 0.

term.description: Parliamentary term 0–10, exclusive with mandate_date; omitting both selects members in office today.

name: euparl_search_meps

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A code, term, or language is unsupported; name_contains has no letter or digit; or mandate_date is not a real date or is after today (UTC). `invalid_mode_fields`: A nonzero local offset lacks a snapshot, or mandate_date is combined with term. `snapshot_changed`: The complete roster or normalized retrieval scope changed. `upstream_paging_stalled`: Complete roster acquisition repeats a page before exhaustion. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Complete member records on the selected local page.
Published member identity and available roster context.

country.description: Published country in this roster context; may be absent on historical rosters.

mep_id.description: Canonical decimal person identifier for euparl_get_mep.

political_group.description: Published political group in this roster context; never inferred for a vote date.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size: the requested limit, clamped to the collection's page cap and, on a 10000-result search, to the results left in the window.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.

title: Find members of the European Parliament
